identity.name: @epdoc/strava-app
identity.purpose: Business logic for Strava KML/GPX/PDF generation

exports.name: BaseClass
exports.description: Extends core BaseClass with app/api accessors

patterns.name: KML Export
patterns.code:
await app.init(ctx, { strava: true, userSettings: true });
await app.getKml(ctx, { dates, output, activities: true });

patterns.name: GPX Export
patterns.code:
await app.init(ctx, { strava: true, userSettings: true });
await app.getGpx(ctx, { dates, output, activities: true, laps: true });

patterns.name: PDF Export
patterns.when: Generating Acroforms XML for PDF forms
patterns.code:
await app.init(ctx, { strava: true, userSettings: true });
await app.getPdf(ctx, { dates, output });
